svg.text: Purple: pivots (highest bit of each row)
Red: extra 1s in pivot columns, to clear
Pivot columns 3, 2, 0 now each hold one 1
Grey column: not a pivot column, anything goes
k-th smallest (k from 0): the bits of k (c₂ c₁ c₀) are the choice
c₀ = b[0], c₁ = b[2], c₂ = b[3] (numbered by pivot, low to high)
The value’s bits at pivots 3, 2, 0 are exactly the bits of k, so values sort in the order of k
